name: Horror Starter
tagline: CoD-feel night shooter — an open industrial yard plus a lit brick cellar
description: A ready-to-play first-person shooter with Call-of-Duty-style feel: snappy grounded WASD movement with sprint, tactical sprint, crouch, slide, jump and auto-mantle; mouse-look with ADS sensitivity scaling; a two-weapon loadout (Vityaz, MP5) held by a skinned arms rig with procedural CoD-style viewmodel, ADS, recoil, muzzle flash, shell ejection, reload choreography and weapon swap; a third-person body for external cameras. Two maps: the open 120 x 120 m night YARD (warehouses, containers, checkpoint, storage yard, 30+ CC0 Poly Haven props, street/security lights, moon, fog) and the closed brick CELLAR. Everything gameplay lives in plain project scripts you can read and change.
